label: Advocacy
definition: Content designed to raise awareness or drive action around social or political causes.

label: Analysis
definition: Evaluates or interprets a subject through critical reasoning or structured breakdown.

label: Behind-the-Scenes
definition: Reveals the process or preparation behind a finished product or performance.

label: Breakdown
definition: Dissects a topic into parts for clarity, often using visuals or step-by-step commentary.

label: Campaign
definition: Showcases a coordinated content effort, usually tied to a launch, cause, or partnership.

label: Case Study
definition: Presents a real-world example to explain how something worked or failed.

label: Challenge
definition: Content built around a task, constraint, or dare, often designed to test limits or entertain.

label: Commentary
definition: Offers subjective opinion or interpretation of an existing event, work, or trend.

label: Comparison
definition: Contrasts two or more options, tools, products, or perspectives.

label: Compilation
definition: Combines multiple short clips or moments into a single cohesive video.

label: Debate
definition: Presents two or more sides of an argument, often in direct or live conversation.

label: Deep Dive
definition: Explores a topic in high detail, usually beyond surface-level information.

label: Demo
definition: Demonstrates how a product or process works, often in real time.

label: DIY
definition: Shows how to make or build something step by step using accessible materials.

label: Explained
definition: Simplifies a topic or concept through accessible language and examples.

label: Experiment
definition: Tests a hypothesis or open question with an uncertain outcome, in real time, usually with unexpected or educational results.

label: FAQ
definition: Answers a set of frequently asked questions about a topic, product, or process.

label: First Impressions
definition: Initial reactions to a new product, trend, or experience — usually unfiltered.

label: Guide
definition: A reference-style walk-through of a task, platform, or system, organized for the viewer to follow or return to.

label: Hack
definition: Shows a shortcut or unconventional method to achieve a result quickly or efficiently.

label: Haul
definition: Displays and discusses items recently purchased, often with mini-reviews.

label: Highlight
definition: Shows standout or peak moments from a longer piece of content or event.

label: Interview
definition: Features a conversation between host and guest(s) to extract insight or perspective.

label: Lists
definition: Presents a ranked or grouped set of recommendations, facts, or ideas.

label: Live
definition: Content streamed in real-time, often interactive or unedited.
note: Retired in v2.0. Live broadcast is recorded in the release_mode metadata field; choose the Format by structure. Code reserved, never reused.

label: Mini
definition: Delivers a shorter or condensed version of a traditionally longer content type.

label: Montage
definition: A fast-paced edit showing a sequence of related visuals or actions, often set to music.

label: Observation
definition: Content based on quiet or neutral watching — often animals, environments, or processes.

label: Overview
definition: Presents a broad explanation of a topic, usually without deep technical detail.

label: Performance
definition: Content where the creator performs music, art, theater, or physical feats for the audience, informal or self-staged.

label: Pitch
definition: Proposes an idea, product, or plan in a persuasive and structured format.

label: Planning
definition: Content that walks through goal-setting, strategy, or logistical prep for future actions.

label: Podcasts
definition: Long-form audio or video conversations, usually structured around topics or guests.

label: Prank
definition: Content where one party surprises or tricks another for comedic effect.

label: Q&A
definition: Answers audience-submitted or pre-generated questions in a conversational tone.

label: Rant
definition: Expresses strong opinion or frustration in an unfiltered, emotional format.

label: Reading
definition: Content involving someone reading aloud — books, comments, scripts, or essays.

label: Recap
definition: Summarizes key events, lessons, or takeaways from a larger experience or episode.

label: Recipes
definition: Teaches how to prepare a specific dish with ingredients, steps, and tips.

label: Recital
definition: A formal, programmed performance of rehearsed repertoire, often classical music, poetry, or recitation.

label: Reviews
definition: Evaluates and shares opinions on a product, service, or media item.

label: Roasts
definition: Humorous critiques often designed to tease or mock with exaggeration.

label: Roundup
definition: Aggregates several examples, trends, or pieces of news into one piece of content.

label: Session
definition: Captures an unbroken time block of activity like music, drawing, or discussion.

label: Setup
definition: Shows how tools, environments, or systems are arranged and optimized.

label: Showcase
definition: Displays the features or value of a single product, creation, or talent.

label: Speedruns
definition: Attempts to complete a task or game as quickly as possible under specific rules.

label: Storytime
definition: Shares a personal or fictional narrative with a hook, pacing, and emotional arc.

label: Strategy
definition: Outlines a structured plan of action to achieve a result, often in games or business.

label: Test
definition: Puts a product or method through a structured trial to evaluate results.

label: Timelapse
definition: Condenses hours or days into seconds using fast-forwarded footage.

label: Tips
definition: Gives bite-sized advice or insights on how to improve in a given area.

label: Tour
definition: Takes the viewer through a physical or virtual space, such as a home, venue, studio, or city.

label: Trends
definition: Highlights popular styles, challenges, or behavior emerging within a timeframe.

label: Try-On
definition: Models clothing or accessories while commenting on fit, feel, or quality.

label: Tutorials
definition: Instructs the viewer on how to do something through guided, hands-on instruction.

label: Unboxing
definition: Opens and explores a new product, often with commentary on packaging and first impressions.

label: Update
definition: Provides a status report or change log on an ongoing story, project, or journey.

label: Vlogs
definition: Captures daily life, travel, or thought processes in a casual, documentary style.

label: Walkthrough
definition: Leads the viewer through completing a game or software flow in sequence, with detailed explanation; compare Playthrough (72), which is entertainment-led.

label: ASMR
definition: Uses soft sounds or sensory triggers to create a calming or immersive experience.

label: Mashups
definition: Combines elements from multiple sources into one edited piece for entertainment or commentary.

label: Fancam
definition: Fan-shot footage of a live event, focused on a specific performer, moment, or angle.

label: Skit
definition: Short scripted or semi-scripted scene performed for humor or storytelling, including POV skits.

label: Documentary
definition: Long-form, reported or cinematic treatment of a real subject, built on footage, sourcing, and narration.

label: Reaction
definition: Creator responds in real time to another piece of media, with the original shown on screen.

label: Parody
definition: Imitates the structure of a known format or genre for comic or critical effect.

label: Routine
definition: Shows a repeated sequence of personal tasks as it happens, such as a morning routine or Get Ready With Me, usually narrated over the activity.

label: Essay
definition: Argues a single thesis in narrated or written form, built from evidence and reasoning; includes video essays and newsletter essays.

label: Transformation
definition: Shows a subject before and after a change, such as a makeover, renovation, restoration, or glow-up.

label: Follow-Along
definition: Invites the audience to do an activity in real time with the creator, such as a workout, code-along, or study session.

label: Playthrough
definition: Records a creator playing through a game with entertainment-focused commentary (a Let's Play).

label: Announcement
definition: Reveals news, a launch, or upcoming content, including trailers and teasers.

label: Report
definition: Reports a single news story in an anchor or correspondent style, built on sourced facts.
